newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Sao Paulo firms sack 6,990 workers in February.
newsitem.headline: Sao Paulo firms sack 6,990 workers in February.

text.p: Private firms located in Sao Paulo state laid off 6,990 employees in February, compared with the 8,497 workers fired in January, Sao Paulo State Industries Federation (Fiesp) said in a statement.
So far this year, Sao Paulo industries have laid off 15,487 workers or 0.82 percent of the Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, the statement said.
Sixteen out of the 47 sectors included in the survey hired personnel in the period. Twenty-four sacked people and seven maintained their staff unchanged, it said.
In the last 12 months, Sao Paulo firms have sacked 122,654 workers, or 6.11 percent of Sao Paulo's industrial workforce, it said.
